metadata.title: Securitize Stock: Tokenized Assets Hit $5 Billion<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Securitize Stock Jumps 24%, Defying Crypto Slump. Its Tokenized Assets Hit $5 Billion.
A mixed earnings report and a slumping crypto industry weren’t enough to stop Securitize on Tuesday.
